WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.613308 40.357934)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

```sql
WITH fort_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Fort Steuben'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Steubenville'
    AND addr_state = 'OH'
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Azimuth(
      ST_Transform(fg.geom, 4326),
      ST_ValuePoint(
        r.rast,
        ST_Transform(fg.geom, 4326)
      )
    ) * 180 / pi() AS aspect_degrees
  FROM fort_geom fg
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(fg.geom, 4326))
)
SELECT aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_raster;
```
